post.description:
Accept a Chaster webhook and store it in the durable inbox.

Processing (and any slow Puryfi RPC) happens in the background worker, so
Chaster's 10s timeout is never hit.

get.description: Fetch a Chaster session and fetch-or-create its local configuration.

put.description: Update the settings of the current session from the main page.

post.description: Generate (or reuse) the wearer's Puryfi link token.

get.description: Get the configuration of the extension.

put.description:
Update the configuration of the extension.

The body is validated before Chaster is called, and the validated payload
is the local source of truth even if Chaster omits ``config`` from its
response.
